parsed_json.sql: SELECT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, t.target_type, t.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, m.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary t ON t.tid = a.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary m ON m.molregno = act.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = m.molregno WHERE t.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL220' AND t.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND t.tax_id = 9606 AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.chembl_id, a.chembl_id
